svg.title: Who I am: 10+ years, 50+ AWS microservices platform, 3,000 to 1,000 line refactor, over 85% PyTest coverage, 5 domains
svg.desc: Specification sheet. A vernier caliper opens to 10+ years; fifty isometric blocks represent the 50+ AWS microservice platform he contributed to; a press compresses a 3,000-line Python backend to about 1,000 lines with 20% better performance; a gauge reads over 85% PyTest coverage; a Geneva drive indexes through five domains: finance, healthcare, retail, pharma and insurance.
svg.text: Senior backend engineer with 10+ years across the full SDLC. Led backend teams at Freddie Mac
and Humana, and API development at CVS Health.
Now building FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS that serve ML forecasting models at Freddie
Mac. Works AI-driven with Claude Code + MCP.
